mentions.name: Downread
mentions.description: Advanced RSS reader that pushes the boundaries of what an RSS reader can do. It includes podcast capabilities with background play, queuing, and video streaming, and is adding posting and commenting within the reader based on rss.chat and the webmention protocol, with mobile apps planned.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on http://downread.com/, making it an advanced RSS reader.
mentions.author: tjansen
